limitations: A worker token granted specific projects that calls GET /feed without project now gets 400 where it got the global feed; no client change ships here, adoption by the agentihooks brain adapter belongs to SV2-BRP-05.
Freshness is measured from the snapshot file time; a vault copied or restored without file times reads fresh or stale wrongly until the next tick.
The project signal cap at BRAIN_PROJECT_FEED_KNOWLEDGE has no dedicated test.
When the tick prompt hits its hard truncation, the tail is cut, which now holds the project intent task.
Snapshot ownership compares second resolution stamps; two ticks in the same second both write.
Signal files written by POST /marker into amygdala are not yet part of project signals; only arc signal markers are.
